snippet.title: Wolkenkratzer: Shinpan no Tou PS1 Tower of Trials (First Tower) Ranger Playthrough
snippet.description:
Wolkenkratzer: Shinpan no Tou is an interesting Japan-only game which combines elements of JRPGs, roguelites, and 3D fighting games. And to add to the list of PS1 cliches, it has a bizarre almost tank-control combat system!

Before you can challenge the 50-floor skyscraper proper, you have to get through this 20-floor tower of trials. Once you've familiarized yourself with the various enemy's attack patterns the main challenge comes from being at the mercy of randomized drops. For example, the random technique scroll I used at the beginning gave me an almost useless attack. On the other hand, I managed to upgrade to half plate armor relatively early on.

Played on a modern Hori RAP arcade stick using adapters. Captured from a Playstation SCPH-5501 using HD Retrovision cables and Elgato HD S with OSSC.
